name: jono-consultancy-api-automation
description: BDD-style API automation for Jono Consultancy

scripts.test:smoke:allure: rm -rf reports/allure-results/smoke reports/allure-html/smoke reports/smoke && cross-env ALLURE_RESULTS_DIR=reports/allure-results/smoke PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=reports/smoke npm run test:smoke && allure generate reports/allure-results/smoke --clean --output reports/allure-html/smoke
scripts.test:regression:allure: rm -rf reports/allure-results/regression reports/allure-html/regression reports/regression && cross-env ALLURE_RESULTS_DIR=reports/allure-results/regression PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=reports/regression npm run test:regression && allure generate reports/allure-results/regression --clean --output reports/allure-html/regression
scripts.test:production-safe: bddgen && cross-env ALLOW_READONLY_SECURITY_PROBES=true ALLOW_PRODUCTION_SECURITY_PROBES=true SECURITY_TEST_BASE_URL=https://api.jonoconsultancy.com playwright test --grep @ProductionSafeProbe
scripts.test:security:allure: rm -rf reports/allure-results/security reports/allure-html/security reports/security && cross-env ALLURE_RESULTS_DIR=reports/allure-results/security PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=reports/security npm run test:security && allure generate reports/allure-results/security --clean --output reports/allure-html/security
